therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus inadequately controlled on thiazolidinedione (TZD) therapy alone
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in HbA1c at Week 24

results.effect_size: Saxagliptin 2.5 mg: -0.66% vs placebo -0.30% (difference -0.36%); Saxagliptin 5 mg: -0.94% vs placebo -0.30% (difference -0.64%)
biomarker_changes: Saxagliptin 2.5 mg + TZD: FPG adjusted mean change -14.3 mg/dL vs placebo -2.8 mg/dL
Saxagliptin 5 mg + TZD: FPG adjusted mean change -17.3 mg/dL vs placebo -2.8 mg/dL
Saxagliptin 2.5 mg + TZD: PPG AUC adjusted mean change -7849 mg*min/dL vs placebo -2690 mg*min/dL
Saxagliptin 5 mg + TZD: PPG AUC adjusted mean change -9269 mg*min/dL vs placebo -2690 mg*min/dL
42.2% of saxagliptin 2.5 mg + TZD patients achieved A1c <7% vs 25.6% placebo
41.8% of saxagliptin 5 mg + TZD patients achieved A1c <7% vs 25.6% placebo
safety_signals: Serious adverse events were infrequent and distributed across arms
Coronary artery disease reported in 3/184 placebo+TZD, 1/195 saxagliptin 2.5 mg+TZD
Cardiac events (acute MI, cardiac failure, angina, atrial fibrillation) observed at low rates across arms
